description: persist a Work Breakdown Structure document that the calling agent authored by value: validate it, then store it through the standard WBS storage path so it becomes retrievable and executable.
embedding_description: Register an agent-authored work breakdown structure so the platform stores it and makes it retrievable. Persists the document to the knowledge base and the WBS tracking table with authored-by-value provenance after hard-fail validation. Registration never overwrites an existing WBS.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Registration result with keys: wbs_id, status, knowledge_base_path, source_memory_id
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the registration with the wbs_id and knowledge_base_path so the caller can reference the stored document.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The document is stored, focused, and retrievable. Continue with the next step of the current plan; no re-validation is needed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Registering an agent-authored Work Breakdown Structure document. register_authored_work_breakdown_structure accepts {content, wbs_id, manifest_id, phase_number, phase_name}. Validation runs first; nothing is stored when it fails.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: the document failed hard-fail validation — the message lists every finding — or the action arguments do not conform to the schema. AlreadyRegistered: a WBS with this wbs_id already exists; registration never overwrites. StorageError: the knowledge base or state write failed after validation passed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Validation failures: repair the listed findings in the authored document (validate_authored_work_breakdown_structure gives the same report without side effects) and resubmit. Already-registered: revise the existing document with patch_work_breakdown_structure instead of re-registering. Storage failures: retry once the platform reports healthy.
